description: This file defines a PHP class `Customer` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Model\Extension\Opencart\Report`. The class extends an engine Model and contains methods for retrieving various customer-related reports such as total customers by day, week, month, and year, as well as detailed data on customers, orders, and other metrics used within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin reporting system.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents customer-related report data and includes methods to gather statistical data such as total customers by day, week, month, and year, as well as detailed customer and order information.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array with hourly counts of new customers for the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array with daily counts of new customers over the past week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array with daily counts of new customers over the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array with monthly counts of new customers over the past year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Gets a list of customers based on provided filter data such as date range, group, and other filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers, optionally filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches customer order data with various filters, including date range, customer name, status, and limits.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders, optionally filtered by date range and other criteria.
